# SafeOrStolen

> SafeOrStolen is a stolen-item verification hub for buyers and sellers of used goods. It supports phones, vehicles, license plates, serial-numbered electronics and power tools, firearms, bicycles, boats, and marketplace listings. Checks use SafeOrStolen's own stolen-item reports, public web results, and AI analysis. Bicycle checks also query Bike Index, and firearm checks also query HotGunz. SafeOrStolen does not search carrier blacklists, NICB, NMVTIS, NCIC, police, insurance, or DMV databases.

## Core tools

## Vehicle answer
Match the 17-character VIN on the dashboard, driver-door jamb, title, and registration. Search NICB VINCheck separately for participating theft and total-loss records. Buy an NMVTIS report through an approved provider for title information. Consider a Carfax or AutoCheck report, inspect for VIN tampering, and ask local police whether they accept public VIN-check requests. SafeOrStolen complements these steps; it does not query those official or commercial systems.

## Results and records
Results use three states: STOLEN for strong evidence, CLEAR when completed checks return clean, and NOT FOUND / UNKNOWN otherwise. A clean check can create a Proof of Clean Purchase verification record showing what was checked and when. It is not a legal document, title, ownership proof, or guarantee.

## Access and pricing
An account is required to run checks. A free account includes two checks. Additional checks are $0.99 each, or $10 per month for unlimited checks. SafeOrStolen is available on the web and as an installable web app.
